confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from a search of the RBA site, which gave 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of crowdsourced cost-of-living data (MyLifeElsewhere and TravelTables). Those sources disagree with each other and some figures are dated. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price, using typical Taiwan bar markups, not from direct price data. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tainan is a mid-sized Taiwanese tourist city. Its prices are slightly below Taipei's and similar to Taichung and Kaohsiung.
